document.title: Checklist of EN 60601-1-6:2010+A1:2015+A2:2021
document.doc_type: 检测报告/合规检查清单

tests.item: Conditions for application to ME EQUIPMENT - The ME EQUIPMENT shall provide adequate USABILITY such that the RISks resulting from NORMAL USE, i.e. CORRECT USE and USE ERROR, are acceptable.
tests.condition: Compliance with 4.2 and other clauses and subclauses of this collateral standard

tests.item: USABILITY ENGINEERING PROCESS for ME EQUIPMENT - A USABILITY ENGINEERING PROCESS complying with IEC 62366-1:2015+A1:2020 shall be performed except planning for and execution of production and POST-PRODUCTION monitoring and maintenance of the USABILITY ENGINEERING PROCESS
tests.condition: USABILITY ENGINEERING PROCESS has been performed, please see the inspection of the USABILITY ENGINEERING file

tests.item: The instructions for use include a brief description of the ME EQUIPMENT, its physical operating principles and significant physical and performance characteristics relevant to its use.
tests.condition: Inspect the instruction for use to include information required

tests.item: The same information shall also be included in the technical description, if this is provided as a separate document.
tests.condition: Inspect the instruction for use to include information required

tests.item: The instructions for use contain a summary of the USE SPECIFICATION as specified in IEC 62366-1:2015+A1:2020, 5.1.
tests.condition: Inspect the instruction for use to include use specification as specified in IEC 62366-1.

semantic_fragments.content: A USABILITY ENGINEERING PROCESS complying with IEC 62366-1:2015+A1:2020 shall be performed except: - the planning for and execution of production and POST-PRODUCTION monitoring in the context of applying the USABILITY ENGINEERING PROCESS within the framework of ISO 14971, and - maintenance of the USABILITY ENGINEERING PROCESS.

The instructions for use contain a summary of the USE SPECIFICATION as specified in IEC 62366-1:2015+A1:2020, 5.1. The instructions for use include a brief description of the ME EQUIPMENT, its physical operating principles and significant physical and performance characteristics relevant to its use.
